title: Dallas Private Brewery Limousine Tour
blurb: Private Limousine Tour to the Best Dallas Breweries You will travel in style and try the best craft beer in Dallas at Dallas famous breweries. Dallas, TX, has become a focal point for the craft beer movement nationwide, with dozens of new breweries opening across the area. We will explore the blossoming craft beer scene in the company of a local expert. This tasting tour will take you to some of the most popular establishments as well as the hard-to-find ones springing up around the DFW metroplex. Every brewery have english speaking guide.
